text: Decentralizing data processing across secure nodes, using techniques such as federated learning and homomorphic encryption, circumvents the privacy and security exposure of centralized data management and lowers breach risk.

abstract: Through decentralizing data processing across secure nodes, these startups help circumvent the privacy and security issues associated with centralized data management, thus reducing the risk of data breaches.
